# Sales Dashboard Chart Set for Manager Review

A compact presentation set works best here: one trend view, one regional comparison, and one composition view. The dataset covers two quarters across four regions, so the charts should emphasize both performance by region and overall change over time.

## Chart Plan and Data Layout

### 1) Line Chart — Revenue Trend by Quarter
Use a line chart with:
- X-axis: **Quarter**
- Y-axis: **Revenue**
- Series: **North, South, East, West**

Plotted values:
- North: 54,000 → 59,000
- South: 41,000 → 43,000
- East: 47,000 → 50,000
- West: 33,000 → 36,000

### 2) Bar Chart — Profit by Region and Quarter
Use a grouped bar chart with:
- X-axis: **Region**
- Y-axis: **Profit**
- Grouping: **2024-Q1 vs 2024-Q2**

Plotted values:
- North: 8,200 → 9,100
- South: 6,100 → 6,400
- East: 7,400 → 7,900
- West: 4,200 → 4,800

### 3) Pie Chart — Q2 Revenue Share by Region
Use a pie chart for **2024-Q2 revenue mix**:
- North: 59,000
- South: 43,000
- East: 50,000
- West: 36,000

Share of Q2 revenue:
- North: **32.2%**
- East: **27.3%**
- South: **23.5%**
- West: **19.7%**

## Presentation-Ready Chart Specs

Chart | Best Use | Key Data | Design Tip
Revenue line chart | Show growth trend | Revenue by quarter for all regions | Use one color per region and markers on each quarter point
Profit bar chart | Compare regional profitability | Profit by region across Q1 and Q2 | Sort regions North, East, South, West for easier reading
Revenue pie chart | Show Q2 mix | Q2 revenue by region | Keep labels outside slices and highlight North

## 4 Concise Insights

- **North leads in both revenue and profit** in both quarters, making it the strongest region overall.
- **All regions grew from Q1 to Q2**, but North showed the largest absolute revenue gain at **+5,000**.
- **West remains the smallest contributor** in both revenue and profit, though it improved modestly in Q2.
- **Profit growth is steady but narrower than revenue growth**, suggesting margins are improving only gradually.

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Create in Power BI](https://powerbi.microsoft.com/)

- Spreadsheet charting guidance: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/excel
- Business intelligence dashboards: https://powerbi.microsoft.com/
- Chart basics and best practices: https://www.tableau.com/learn/articles/data-visualization-tips
